historical_aggregate_not_per_job.why: Counts from the 2026-10-05 Studio scan are not per-job records. This file does not contain the BF-*.json bodies, so those counts cannot name the current-system worker.

sample_keys_example.note: cursor_pid and cursor_log would be per-job cursor evidence if the run file is readable on Studio. The file is not in this repo, so this example is not a worker assignment.

note: Current-system worker comes only from per-job records: a worker/worker_id/executor field, or cursor_pid/cursor_log/cursor.pid, or grok_pid/grok_log/grok.pid. Jobs without that are skipped. implied_primary and aggregate counts are not used. If nothing qualifies, the hint is UNKNOWN.
